Sandbox_DanTraitsAgeEnabled_tooltip:
Characters are in their 20s, 30s or 40s, which changes their starting skills and how some traits work.
Off: the age traits do nothing.
Sandbox_DanTraitsAgeDefault_tooltip: The age of a character who takes neither age trait. Rounds down to the decade: 20-29, 30-39, 40-49.
Sandbox_DanTraitsAgeBonus20s_tooltip: Extra levels a new character in their 20s gets in their profession's main skill.
Sandbox_DanTraitsAgeBonus30s_tooltip: Extra levels a new character in their 30s gets in their profession's main skill.
Sandbox_DanTraitsAgeBonus40s_tooltip: Extra levels a new character in their 40s gets in their profession's main skill.
Sandbox_DanTraitsBloodEnabled_tooltip:
Bleeding drains blood instead of health: pale, then light-headed, then shock. Blood comes back with water, food and rest.
Off: vanilla bleeding.
Sandbox_DanTraitsInfectionEnabled_toolti:
Wounds can take an infection that grows: local, then fever, then sepsis. Clean and dress wounds early; once it spreads, only a course of antibiotics (a dose every eight hours) stops it.
Off: vanilla wound infection.
Sandbox_DanTraitsWoundCareEnabled_toolti:
Dressings wear out and need changing, deep wounds heal slowly unstitched and can open again, fresh stitches can tear under strain, splints are set with a First Aid roll, and walking on a broken leg makes it worse.
Off: vanilla wound care.
Sandbox_DanTraitsConcussionEnabled_toolt:
Hard falls, car crashes and blows to the head can concuss: headache, nausea, dizzy spells, light hurts; a bad one knocks you out. Rest heals it; a helmet helps.
Off: no concussion.
Sandbox_DanTraitsVitalityEnabled_tooltip:
Diet, exercise and sleep roll into a slow Vitality score: run down or thriving changes recovery, mood, health and how the traits behave, and Thriving doubles Fitness and Strength experience.
Off: no score and no effects.
Sandbox_DanTraitsSleepLightEnabled_toolt:
Dark sleep is deeper and scores better; a bright room makes sleep shallow and light can wake you. Curtains and switches matter.
Off: light does not affect sleep.
Sandbox_DanTraitsHangoverEnabled_tooltip:
Drinking past a buzz builds a hangover for the morning after: headache, low mood, thirst, tiredness, and a worse night's sleep.
Off: no hangovers.
Sandbox_DanTraitsDrinkReliefEnabled_tool:
Drink eases pain and panic in proportion to how drunk you are, instead of one sip counting as a full dose of painkiller and beta blocker.
Off: vanilla, any drink is a full dose.
Sandbox_DanTraitsSunburnEnabled_tooltip:
Hours in the summer sun on bare skin burn it: a day of pain on each burnt part, and a worse night. Clothing, a hat, shade and sun block protect, and skin toughens with each burn.
Off: no sunburn.
Sandbox_DanTraitsDehydrationEnabled_tool:
Hours spent thirsty bring a headache, tiredness and slower endurance recovery until you drink.
Off: vanilla thirst only.
Sandbox_DanTraitsMedSideEffectChance_too:
The chance in percent, on each day a medication is taken, that its mild side effect shows up for a few hours. Taking too many at once is always harmful.
0: no side effects.
Sandbox_DanTraitsStartingMedication_tool:
Characters with a medical trait start with its medication: beta blockers (Heart Condition), anticonvulsants (Epilepsy), insulin pens or metformin (Diabetes) and an inhaler (Asthma).
Off: they start with none and have to find it. Daily pills taken that morning still wear off over a few days.
